notes.title: Bundle Currently On Sale!
notes.content:
[b]I'm pleased to announce that the newest title, Quiver Dick's Epic Book of Fairy Fails is coming soon to Steam! Be sure to check it out and wishlist it for notifications when it's released!

Thank you all for your continued support along the way and making this all possible! I can't wait to hear what you think!

In the meantime, feel free to check out the other games in the bundle and get caught up with the story!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7659/The_Terrible_Metal_as_Phuk_Deported_Tale_of_Damned_Daniel_Chronicles_of_Quiver_Dick_Collection_Bundle/

- Crankage Games[/b]
